root_text: Several folks I know are battling a bug they can't shake. Meanwhile, China’s seeing a surge in respiratory illnesses like HMPV and Influenza A, overwhelming hospitals. Let’s hope this isn’t 2020 all over again. Stay safe and informed! #HMPV
